mtrr_methylation.desc: MTRR A66G G allele frequency: 42%. Affects MTR regeneration and B12 recycling.
mtrr_methylation.notes: MTRR regenerates MTR enzyme. GG genotype has high methylmalonic acid - monitor in pregnancy.

comt_methylation.desc: COMT Met allele frequency: 40%. Affects catecholamine and estrogen metabolism.
comt_methylation.notes: Slow COMT benefits from cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, kale) which support estrogen clearance via alternative pathways.

cyp11b2_hypertension.desc: CYP11B2 T allele frequency: 40%. Affects aldosterone synthase and sodium retention.
cyp11b2_hypertension.notes: CYP11B2 regulates aldosterone production. T allele increases salt sensitivity and hypertension risk.

agtr1_hypertension.desc: AGTR1 T allele frequency: 45%. Affects angiotensin II receptor type 1 activity.
agtr1_hypertension.notes: AGTR1 mediates vasoconstriction. High activity benefits from potassium-rich foods (bananas, leafy greens, potatoes).

lepr_satiety.desc: LEPR Q223R G allele frequency: 40%. Affects leptin receptor function and satiety signaling.
lepr_satiety.notes: GG homozygotes have impaired leptin signaling, leading to reduced satiety. Regular meal timing and protein-rich foods may help.

bdnf_fat_appetite.desc: BDNF Val66Met Met allele frequency: 20%. Affects appetite regulation specifically in response to dietary fat.
bdnf_fat_appetite.notes: BDNF Met carriers do NOT show hyperphagia on low-fat or high-sucrose diets - the effect is FAT-SPECIFIC. Low-fat diet is the targeted intervention.

cd36_fat_taste.desc: CD36 A allele frequency: 42%. Affects oral fat taste receptor sensitivity.
cd36_fat_taste.notes: AA genotype (~25% Europeans) have higher fat detection thresholds. They may need to consciously track fat intake rather than relying on taste satisfaction.

fads2_vegetarian.desc: FADS2 insertion allele frequency: 30%. Represents positive selection for plant-to-animal fatty acid conversion in populations with long vegetarian traditions.
fads2_vegetarian.notes: High converters efficiently make EPA/DHA from plants but also convert omega-6 to inflammatory arachidonic acid. Traditional South Asian diets with mustard oil and ghee are more compatible than Western vegetable oil-heavy diets.

clock_chronotype.desc: CLOCK 3111C allele frequency: 26%. Affects circadian rhythm and meal timing response.
clock_chronotype.notes: Evening chronotypes gain more weight from late eating. Eating the same calories earlier in the day produces better metabolic outcomes.

per1_meal_timing.desc: PER1 rs2735611 frequency: 32%. Affects response to meal timing consistency.
per1_meal_timing.notes: PER1 regulates circadian rhythms. High responders benefit significantly from eating at the same times daily.

dao_histamine.desc: DAO rs2052129 T allele frequency: 20%. Affects diamine oxidase activity and histamine breakdown.
dao_histamine.notes: DAO enzyme breaks down dietary histamine. Low activity causes headaches, flushing, GI symptoms after high-histamine foods. Fresh foods are safer than aged/fermented.

adora2a_caffeine_anxiety.desc: ADORA2A rs5751876 frequency: 38%. Affects adenosine receptor sensitivity to caffeine (separate from metabolism speed).
adora2a_caffeine_anxiety.notes: ADORA2A affects how caffeine FEELS, not how fast you metabolize it. Even fast CYP1A2 metabolizers can be ADORA2A-sensitive and experience anxiety or insomnia from caffeine.

abcg2_gout.desc: ABCG2 rs2231142 T allele frequency: 10%. Affects uric acid transport - dysfunction leads to hyperuricemia and gout.
abcg2_gout.notes: ABCG2 is a urate transporter. Dysfunction causes uric acid accumulation. Pacific Islanders and Filipinos have highest frequencies globally.

slc2a9_urate.desc: SLC2A9 rs734553 frequency: 78%. Affects renal urate handling. Near-fixed in Pacific Islanders (98-100%).
slc2a9_urate.notes: SLC2A9 affects how kidneys handle uric acid. Combined with ABCG2 variants, explains extremely high gout rates in Pacific Islander populations.

ashkenazi_ldlr_fh.desc: LDLR G197del carrier frequency: 0%. Causes familial hypercholesterolemia (FH).
ashkenazi_ldlr_fh.notes: FH causes very high LDL from birth. Heterozygotes have 2-3x normal LDL. Early statin therapy dramatically reduces cardiovascular events. Diet alone is usually insufficient for FH.

mthfr_folate.desc: MTHFR 677T allele frequency: 9%. Lower prevalence of MTHFR variants.
mthfr_folate.notes: MTHFR C677T T allele: 9%. TT genotype (~0% of population) has significantly reduced enzyme function.

fto_obesity.desc: FTO rs9939609 A allele frequency: 49%. Higher frequency of reduced satiety signaling.
fto_obesity.notes: FTO rs9939609 A allele: 49%. The POUNDS LOST trial confirmed protein-satiety interaction.

hfe_iron_overload.desc: HFE C282Y allele frequency: 0.01%. Variant virtually absent in this population.
hfe_iron_overload.notes: HFE C282Y: 0.01%. This variant is largely European-specific. ~5-10% of European-descent homozygotes develop clinical hemochromatosis.

tas2r38_bitter.desc: TAS2R38 PAV taster haplotype frequency: 65%. Higher proportion of supertasters who perceive intense bitterness.
tas2r38_bitter.notes: TAS2R38 PAV frequency: 65%. PAV/PAV supertasters (~42%) perceive PROP/PTC as intensely bitter.

tcf7l2_diabetes.desc: TCF7L2 rs7903146 T allele frequency: 30%. Elevated genetic risk for type 2 diabetes in this population.
tcf7l2_diabetes.notes: TCF7L2 rs7903146 T allele: 30%. Strongest common genetic predictor of T2DM risk. Diet-gene interaction well-documented.

bco1_vitamin_a.desc: BCO1 rs12934922 T allele frequency: 30%. Higher proportion with efficient beta-carotene conversion.
bco1_vitamin_a.notes: BCO1 rs12934922 T allele: 30%. Up to 45% of population may be poor converters. Especially important for plant-based diets.

mc4r_appetite.desc: MC4R rs17782313 C allele frequency: 29%. Higher genetic appetite drive in this population.
mc4r_appetite.notes: MC4R rs17782313 C allele: 29%. Second strongest obesity GWAS signal after FTO. Meta-analysis of 48,560 participants confirms appetite association.

ace_salt_sensitivity.desc: ACE I/D D allele frequency: 60%. DD genotype common; II genotype (~16%) is salt-sensitive.
ace_salt_sensitivity.notes: ACE D allele: 60%. The I/D polymorphism is a 287bp Alu insertion/deletion. Strongest single-gene predictor of salt-sensitive blood pressure response.

nat2_acetylator.desc: NAT2 slow acetylator phenotype frequency: 52%. Majority are slow acetylators.
nat2_acetylator.notes: NAT2 slow acetylator frequency: 52%. Phenotype frequency used (not single SNP). East Asians have lowest slow acetylator rates (~10-25%); Europeans/Africans highest (~50-70%).

lipc_hdl.desc: LIPC rs1800588 T allele: 53%. Lower hepatic lipase activity common.
lipc_hdl.notes: LIPC T allele: 53%. Framingham Study showed strong gene-diet interaction with dietary fat.

ppara_pufa.desc: PPARA rs1800206 Val162 allele: 1%. Variant is rare.
ppara_pufa.notes: PPARA Val162: 1%. Rare but highly actionable. STOP-NIDDM trial showed 1.9x diabetes risk is diet-modifiable.

drd2_food_reward.desc: DRD2 rs1800497 A1 allele: 38%. Reduced dopamine receptor density common.
drd2_food_reward.notes: DRD2 A1 allele: 38%. Associated with food addiction patterns and preference for fried/sugary foods.

fut2_b12.desc: FUT2 rs601338: ~52% secretors. Mixed B12 absorption genetics.
fut2_b12.notes: FUT2 non-secretor allele: 48%. Secretor status affects gut microbiome and B12 absorption.

gc_vitamin_d.desc: GC rs2282679 C allele: 8%. Most have efficient vitamin D binding.
gc_vitamin_d.notes: GC C allele: 8%. Encodes vitamin D binding protein. Combined with CYP2R1 for vitamin D genetic risk score.

pemt_choline.desc: PEMT rs12325817 C allele: 65%. Mixed choline synthesis capacity.
pemt_choline.notes: PEMT C allele: 65%. ~75% carry at least one C allele. Sex-specific effect - women more vulnerable to deficiency.

fabp2_fat_absorption.desc: FABP2 rs1799883 Thr54 allele: 25%. Standard fat absorption predominates.
fabp2_fat_absorption.notes: FABP2 Thr54: 25%. Well-replicated from Pima Indians through Finnish and Japanese populations.

tmprss6_iron.desc: TMPRSS6 rs855791 T allele: 15%. Higher iron absorption predominates.
tmprss6_iron.notes: TMPRSS6 T allele: 15%. Modulates hepcidin regulation. TT individuals absorb 30% less iron than CC.

agt_salt.desc: AGT rs699 T allele: 90%. Most carry salt-sensitive variant.
agt_salt.notes: AGT T allele: 90%. T is ancestral allele (high in African populations). Over 300 epidemiological studies support salt-BP link.

adrb2_weight_loss.desc: ADRB2 rs1042714 Glu27 allele: 25%. Mixed weight loss genetics.
adrb2_weight_loss.notes: ADRB2 Glu27: 25%. Meta-analysis of 18 studies (n=9,995) confirms obesity association.

tas1r2_sweet.desc: TAS1R2 rs35874116 T allele: 50%. Variable sweet taste genetics.
tas1r2_sweet.notes: TAS1R2 T allele: 50%. Sweet taste receptor gene. Effect strongest in those with BMI≥25.

oprm1_food_reward.desc: OPRM1 rs1799971 G allele: 2%. Most have standard food pleasure response.
oprm1_food_reward.notes: OPRM1 G allele: 2%. Dramatic population variation (2% African to 40% East Asian). Combined with DRD2 predicts binge eating.

adrb3_thermogenesis.desc: ADRB3 rs4994 Arg64 allele: 10%. Some reduced thermogenesis genetics.
adrb3_thermogenesis.notes: ADRB3 Arg64: 10%. Meta-analyses confirm childhood obesity association, especially in East Asians.

irs1_insulin.desc: IRS1 rs2943641 C allele: 55%. Mixed insulin signaling genetics.
irs1_insulin.notes: IRS1 C allele: 55%. POUNDS LOST trial (n=738) validated diet-gene interaction across European and Puerto Rican populations.

pparg_adipocyte.desc: PPARG rs1801282 Ala12 allele: 2%. Ala12 variant rare in this population.
pparg_adipocyte.notes: PPARG Ala12: 2%. Meta-analysis of 73 studies (131,863 subjects) confirms T2DM association. Nearly absent in African populations.

ugt1a1_fasting.notes: UGT1A1 *28: 45%. Gilbert's affects ~5-10% of population. Fasting, infection, stress trigger mild jaundice.

slc23a1_vitamin_c.notes: 1000G YRI/GWD/MSL/ESN; monomorphic for G. Note: separate African-specific variant rs35817838 reduces SVCT1 by 75% but is not tracked here

tcn2_b12_transport.notes: YRI C=78.7%, GWD C=80.5%, MSL C=81.8%, ESN C=77.3%; ancestral allele highly conserved

slc30a8_zinc.notes: YRI T=6.9%, GWD T=5.3%, MSL T=5.9%, ESN T=6.1%; lowest protective allele globally

pcsk9_ldl.notes: Confirmed 0% in 1000G YRI/GWD/MSL/ESN. IMPORTANT: West Africans carry alternative PCSK9 LOF variants — C679X at 1.4-3.7% (Yoruba 1.4%, Zimbabwe 3.7%, Burkina Faso/Benin up to 6.9% in some ethnic groups) providing equivalent cardioprotection

ldlr_cholesterol.notes: 1000G YRI C allele ~91%, GWD ~90%. Highest LDLR efficiency globally

lpl_triglycerides.notes: 1000G YRI ~2.8%, GWD ~2.2%, MSL ~1.8%. Lowest S447X frequency globally

npy_appetite.notes: Ancestral T allele predominates; may reflect historical selection for robust appetite drive

lactase_persistence.desc: LP ABSENT in traditional Inuit. Any LP derives from European admixture. Traditional diet had no dairy - entirely marine mammal and fish based.
lactase_persistence.notes: LP ABSENT in traditional Inuit. Any LP derives from European admixture. Traditional diet had no dairy - entirely marine mammal and fish based.

starch_digestion.desc: Lower amylase production - hunter-gatherer/pastoral ancestry (2024 pangenome data)
starch_digestion.notes: AMY1 copies: 4.5 (2024 pangenome study). Hunter-gatherer/pastoral ancestry pattern.

pufa_metabolism.desc: Very low G allele (~8%). Limited ability to convert plant ALA to EPA/DHA. Requires preformed long-chain omega-3s.
pufa_metabolism.notes: Low FADS1 efficiency. Preformed DHA/EPA from fish or algae strongly recommended over plant sources.

vitamin_d_metabolism.desc: UV protection; higher dietary vitamin D needs at high latitudes
vitamin_d_metabolism.notes: Low-moderate. Arctic has extreme UV variation. Traditional diet very high in vitamin D from marine mammal fat and fish liver - critical dietary source in low-UV environment.

cholesterol_metabolism.notes: Elevated e4, absent e2. High-fat diet context. Traditional diet was 50-75% fat from marine mammals.

arctic_fat_metabolism.notes: Strong positive selection in Arctic populations. Traditional high-fat marine diet is optimal for carriers.

g6pd_deficiency.desc: G6PD deficiency allele frequency: 0% in this population
g6pd_deficiency.notes: G6PD deficiency causes hemolytic anemia when exposed to oxidative triggers. HbA1c readings may be artificially low.

abca1_r230c.desc: R230C allele frequency: 3% (Indigenous American exclusive variant)

slc16a11_diabetes.desc: SLC16A11 risk haplotype: 10% (Neanderthal-introgressed, alters hepatic lipid metabolism)
slc16a11_diabetes.notes: SLC16A11 affects liver lipid metabolism. Effect is strongest in younger, leaner individuals - early intervention important.

tbc1d4_diabetes.notes: Exercise is especially critical for carriers - preserves glucose uptake despite insulin resistance. Traditional high-fat marine diet is metabolically optimal.

cyp2r1_vitamin_d.desc: CYP2R1 A allele frequency: 32%. Affects liver 25-hydroxylation of vitamin D.
cyp2r1_vitamin_d.notes: AG/GG genotypes are 3.7x more likely to be vitamin D insufficient despite sun exposure.
